title: Ambient-universe small-etale module operations
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X,Y$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ with their small etale sites and regular-function sheaves [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $m$ be any ambient universe parameter. Apply the canonical sectionwise ULift ring transport [def-pur-cochain-coefficient-universe-transport] to the commutative regular-function sheaf [def-sfb-space-quasi-coherent-algebra], with resulting section and module carriers in universe $\max(u+1,m)$; modules are sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over this lifted sheaf. For $f:X\to Y$, use exactly the chart categories of [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Pullback of functions on each chart is the ULift of the actual scheme pullback. The chart diagram has sections $M(T)$, restricted to scalars from the target test $V$, and actual module restriction maps, with their identity and composition laws. Define a direct-image model by a functor whose sections on every $V$ are limits of this diagram with specified projections, natural both in module maps and target-test restrictions. Such models exist and there is a unique natural isomorphism between any two preserving every projection. Select this normalized universal-property model and its direct-image functor. Its left adjoint exists; define the tensor pullback as that left adjoint and retain its adjunction unit and counit. The local tensor $b\otimes s$ on a chart is $b$ times the chart projection of the unit applied to $s$. No equality of independent universes or arbitrary unnormalized functor or map is included.
